case_title.quote: CHOTKAU v. STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption.

number_of_accused.quote: the sole accused has come up with the above appeals
number_of_accused.reason: Judgment expressly identifies a single accused.

accused_gender.quote: the appellant was implicated falsely ... his mother
accused_gender.reason: Accused is referred to as male throughout.

accused_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the accused; 25 is not supported anywhere in the text.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of the accused is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.correct_value: Labourer (per PW-2's cross-examination, accused and his brothers are labourers)
accused_occupation.quote: All the three of them are engaged in the occupation of labourers.
accused_occupation.reason: PW-2's testimony states the accused and his brothers work as labourers, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

accused_socioeconomic_status.correct_value: Very poor; could not afford a lawyer in the Sessions Court, so an amicus was provided
accused_socioeconomic_status.quote: this is a case where the appellant is so poor that he could not afford to engage a lawyer even in the Sessions Court
accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: The judgment explicitly describes the appellant as very poor and unable to afford counsel.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned in the judgment.

victim_gender.quote: the dead body of the girl
victim_gender.reason: Victim is a girl, referred to as female (Uma Devi).

victim_age.quote: took his niece aged about 6 years
victim_age.reason: Victim's age is stated as about six years.

victim_caste.reason: Victim's caste is not stated in the judgment.

victim_religion.reason: Victim's religion is not stated in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the appellant herein took his niece aged about 6 years
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Accused is the victim's uncle, so a relative relationship is supported.

offence_category.quote: Convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 302 and 376
offence_category.reason: Both rape and murder are charged; the value captures only murder.

statutory_provisions.quote: Convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 302 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860
statutory_provisions.reason: IPC ss.302 and 376 are correctly identified.

weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned in the judgment.

evidence_type.quote: the prosecution of the appellant is based on circumstantial evidence
evidence_type.reason: Judgment explicitly states the case rests on circumstantial evidence.

confession.quote: the appellant denied the charges and claimed that he had been falsely implicated
confession.reason: No confession is recorded; the accused denied the charges.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Six-year-old victim; 'rarest of rare' case; appellant's deviant behaviour and abnormal sexual urge (as found by lower courts)
aggravating_circumstances.quote: the appellant has exhibited a deviant behaviour and abnormal sexual urge, thereby forfeiting his right to life
aggravating_circumstances.reason: The judgment records aggravating factors relied on by the lower courts, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are recorded in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced to death by the Sessions Court
trial_court_outcome.reason: Sessions Court convicted and sentenced the accused to death.

high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court confirmed the conviction and sentence
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court confirmed conviction and death sentence; 'Not applicable' is wrong.

final_outcome.quote: the appeals are allowed and the conviction and penalty are set aside
final_outcome.reason: Conviction and sentence set aside with release, which amounts to acquittal.

offence_finally_established.quote: we are not convinced that the guilt of the appellant stood established beyond reasonable doubt
offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was finally established since the conviction was set aside.

imprisonment_type.quote: the conviction and penalty are set aside
imprisonment_type.reason: No imprisonment sentence survives; death sentence was set aside.

imprisonment_years.reason: No imprisonment term is stated; null is appropriate.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral facts summary without the Supreme Court's outcome (e.g., omit the final clause on the Supreme Court's finding)
neutral_facts.quote: but the Supreme Court found contradictions in the testimonies and the delay in transmitting the FIR to be fatal to the prosecution's case
neutral_facts.reason: Facts reveal the court outcome, which neutral_facts must not do. Otherwise facts are accurate.

offence_severity.quote: sentenced to death by the Sessions Court
offence_severity.reason: The judgment gives no minimum or maximum sentence range; the 7-10 years figure is unsupported.

attempt_completion.quote: a ghastly case of rape and murder of a 6 year old child
attempt_completion.reason: Rape and murder are described as completed offences.

physical_harm.quote: the dead body of the girl was found in the sugarcane field
physical_harm.reason: Death of the victim is recorded as physical harm.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Charged with 2 offences (IPC ss.302 and 376); convicted of both by lower courts; both set aside by Supreme Court
number_of_offences.quote: the conviction and penalty are set aside
number_of_offences.reason: Both convictions were set aside, so '2 upheld' is wrong.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss from the offence is recorded; property dispute is only a defence theory.

premeditation_planning.reason: The judgment makes no finding of premeditation or planning.

motive.reason: No established motive for the offence is identified; the property dispute is a defence claim.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Supreme Court did not accept the testimonies of PWs 1 to 3 or the last seen theory; found them completely untrustworthy
key_evidence_accepted.quote: These contradictions make the evidence of PWs 1 to 3 completely untrustworthy.
key_evidence_accepted.reason: The Supreme Court rejected the witness evidence and last-seen theory; it did not accept them.

witness_credibility.quote: These contradictions make the evidence of PWs 1 to 3 completely untrustworthy.
witness_credibility.reason: Accurately reflects the court's finding that PWs 1 to 3 were completely untrustworthy.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Absconding when the body was found, per the prosecution's case
post_offence_conduct.quote: the dead body of the girl was found in the sugarcane field and the appellant was absconding
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment records that the appellant was absconding, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.quote: The appellant shall be released forthwith if not wanted in connection with any other case.
custody_duration.reason: No custody duration is stated in the judgment.

bail_history.reason: No bail history is mentioned in the judgment.

correct_value.trial_judgment: Not stated (Sessions Court date not given)

trial_duration.quote: Judgment and Order dated 18.04.2016 of the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_duration.reason: 18.04.2016 is the High Court order date, not the trial judgment; High Court date is wrongly marked not stated.

legal_representation.quote: S. Nagamuthu, Sr. Adv., Ms. Shivani Misra, Harsh Parashar ... for the Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellant and State match the judgment.

investigation_status.quote: two documents which formed part of the records submitted along with the final report
investigation_status.reason: FIR registration, final report submission, and completed trial are all supported.

procedural_irregularity.quote: Therefore, we hold that the delay of 5 days in transmitting the FIR to the jurisdictional court, especially in the facts and circumstances of this case was fatal.
procedural_irregularity.reason: Five-day FIR delay and failure to medically examine the accused are both identified as irregularities.

appeal_history.quote: the High Court confirmed the conviction and sentence
appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court confirmation, and Supreme Court setting aside are all accurate.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Prosecution argued PWs 1-3 were cogent and trustworthy, no reason to implicate the accused, FIR delay did not prejudice, and forensic/medical evidence is not always mandatory
prosecution_argument.quote: that the forensic/medical evidence is not always mandatory
prosecution_argument.reason: Omits the State's contentions that delay caused no prejudice and that forensic/medical evidence is not always mandatory.

defence_argument.correct_value: Defence argued PW contradictions, FIR delay, last seen theory insufficient, incomplete witness examination, medical/forensic failure, and s.313 non-compliance
defence_argument.quote: that the evidence to support the last seen theory was insufficient to convict the appellant
defence_argument.reason: Omits last-seen theory insufficiency, witness non-examination and s.313 issues; 'gaping hole' is the court's phrase, not the defence's.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the Court must keep in mind five golden principles or the panchsheel
legal_principle_applied.reason: Five golden principles on circumstantial evidence are correctly described.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Sharad Birdhichand Sarda v. State of Maharashtra (1984) 4 SCC 116
precedent_relied_upon.reason: All listed precedents match the judgment's list of cases relied on.

sentencing_rationale.quote: it is one of the rarest of rare cases where a six year old girl had been raped and murdered
sentencing_rationale.reason: Lower courts' rarest-of-rare rationale is accurately summarized, with the Supreme Court overturning it.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The Supreme Court identifies no mitigating factors for sentencing.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Ghastly case of rape and murder of a six-year-old child; lower courts found rarest of rare and deviant behaviour
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: It is a ghastly case of rape and murder of a 6 year old child
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The judgment characterizes the case with aggravating language, so 'None' is contradicted.

other_sentence_order.quote: The appellant shall be released forthwith if not wanted in connection with any other case.
